purpose: Separate technical visibility from biological flower-condition and species-specific colour-state evidence before opening the 720-image evaluation set.

key_observations: a flower can be technically visible but senescent/dried, altering apparent colour
within-flower markings can produce multiple colour terms without representing multiple flower-colour morphs
multiple flowers in one photograph may be visually coherent or discordant and require an explicit rule

flower_visibility.meaning: Can the target flower/petals be visually assessed at all?

flower_condition.rule: Only fresh flowers are eligible to define a species colour-state codebook. Senescent, damaged, and mixed_or_ambiguous flowers remain visible observations but are unresolved/not_evaluable for colour-state calibration unless a later version explicitly validates them.

within_photo_flower_consistency.rule: If multiple flowers are visible, decide whether the diagnostic colour state is consistent between flowers. Do not collapse discordant flowers to a majority state during calibration.

target_flower_bbox_pct.rule: For multiple consistent flowers, select one representative well-exposed flower for quantitative colour extraction; do not combine background or different flowers into one colour region.

colour_pattern.rule: A multi-colour pattern describes within-flower pigmentation and is not itself evidence of multiple morph states.

diagnostic_colour_scope.rule: Species-specific codebooks must declare which floral region distinguishes biological colour states before held-out evaluation.

apparent_petals_colour_terms.type: list of descriptive visible colour terms
apparent_petals_colour_terms.role: exploratory calibration vocabulary only; never a cross-species absolute colour metric

confidence.role: review priority only; confidence alone cannot convert unresolved to resolved

colour_state_gate.otherwise: unresolved or not_evaluable according to the recorded failure reason
